description: Create a release: { repo, tag, title?, notes?, generate_notes?, draft?, prerelease?, target? } -> { output: <release url> }. generate_notes autogenerates from merged PRs.

generate_notes.description: Autogenerate notes from merged PRs since the last release.

tag.description: Tag to release (created at target if it does not exist).

target.description: Target branch or commit SHA for the tag (gh default: the default branch).

response_schema.description: Trimmed stdout of a mutating gh command (gh prints the created/updated URL or a confirmation line; some commands print nothing).
response_schema.title: TextResponse
